sources.title: Title 8, Chapter 5, § 503: Rates and computation of franchise tax
sources.locator: 8 Del. C. § 503(a) (authorized-shares amounts: $175 where authorized capital stock does not exceed 5,000 shares; $250 where more than 5,000 but not more than 10,000; a further $85 on each 10,000 shares or part thereof; assumed par value capital at $400 for each $1,000,000 or fraction thereof), § 503(c) (maximum $200,000, minimum $175; Large Corporate Filer $250,000 for national-exchange-listed corporations meeting the $750,000,000 consolidated revenue/asset conditions with $250,000,000 minimums)
sources.note: Official online statutory text; amounts verified live 2026-10-01. Check current text and session laws before relying on amounts.

sources.title: How To Calculate Franchise Taxes (corp.delaware.gov/frtaxcalc)
sources.locator: Authorized Shares Method tiers ($175 for 5,000 shares or less; $250 for 5,001-10,000; add $85 per additional 10,000 shares or portion thereof; maximum $200,000) with two worked examples (10,005 shares -> $335.00; 100,000 shares -> $1,015.00); Assumed Par Value Capital Method steps 1-5 with the published worked example (gross assets $1,000,000, issued shares 485,000, authorized 1,000,000 shares of $1.00 par + 250,000 shares of $5.00 par -> assumed par $2.061856, assumed par value capital $3,311,856, tax 4 x $400 = $1,600.00; minimum $400; 'rounded up to the next million if it is over $1,000,000'); note that for no-par corporations the authorized shares method always results in the lesser tax
sources.note: Agency calculation instructions; both worked examples verified number-for-number live 2026-10-01. Amounts change — recheck the live page before relying on figures.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 1120, U.S. Corporation Income Tax Return
sources.locator: When To File: 'a corporation must file its income tax return by the 15th day of the 4th month after the end of its tax year'; June 30 fiscal-year exception (15th day of the 3rd month); Saturday/Sunday/legal-holiday next-business-day rule; Form 7004 extensions
sources.note: Current-revision online instructions; verified live 2026-09-29. Recheck the live instructions for the applicable tax year before filing.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 941, Employer's QUARTERLY Federal Tax Return
sources.locator: When Must You File?: 'Your Form 941 is due by the last day of the month that follows the end of the quarter' (April 30 / July 31 / October 31 / January 31); timely-deposit 10-day extension; next-business-day rule
sources.note: Current-revision online instructions; verified live 2026-09-29. Deposit schedules (monthly/semiweekly) are a separate obligation from the quarterly return.
